Emergency Help

Cyber Fraud Emergency 🚨

If you lost money or shared OTP/PIN, follow these steps immediately.

Call 1930 (India)

National Cyber Crime Helpline for reporting online fraud.

✅ Best within 1 hour of fraud
Report Online

File complaint on official portal.

cybercrime.gov.in
Immediate Safety Checklist
  • ✅ If UPI fraud: Contact bank and block UPI
  • ✅ Change passwords immediately
  • ✅ Enable 2FA on Gmail/WhatsApp/Instagram
  • ✅ If AnyDesk installed: uninstall and reset phone
  • ✅ Save screenshots and transaction IDs
⚠️ CyberRaksha only provides guidance. We never ask OTP, password or remote access.
